history.sg_progress: The initial version of the transition preparedness tool was produced using existing resources. However, future iterations of the tool and the creation of a digital platform for the tool will require additional resources that are not currently available. The Administration will make efforts to secure resources, as the financial situation permits, to fully develop the tool as intended. Meanwhile, the Department of Operational Support will continue to engage with missions and assist in the preparations and planning for transitions.

history.board_assessment: While acknowledging the current financial constraints, the Board considers the recommendation to be under implementation.
